sources.title: QUEST+: A general multidimensional Bayesian adaptive psychometric method
sources.checked: Primary abstract and metadata; publisher full-text returned 403
sources.supports: Bayesian adaptive psychometric testing across stimulus dimensions, parameters, outcomes and pair comparisons
sources.boundary: Not a validation of PariView preference model or its five-query budget

sources.title: Perceptual Effects of Adjusting Hearing-Aid Gain by Means of a Machine-Learning Approach Based on Individual User Preference
sources.population: Experienced hearing-aid users with sensorineural hearing loss, age54–83
sources.method: 12 sound scenarios,20 iterative paired comparisons per scenario, subsequent double-blind recording ratings
sources.supports: Prior preferences inform the next pair; outcome differences depend on listening attribute and situation
sources.boundary: KEMAR/laboratory and hearing loss context, not ND audiovisual fitting; no five-query claim

sources.title: Personalizing over-the-counter hearing aids using pairwise comparisons
sources.checked: Primary full-text including abstract, introduction and methods
sources.method: 15 presets, each pair rated4times,420 comparisons per subject; subsequent simulation-based algorithm evaluation
sources.supports: Noisy and sometimes multiple preference points; feedback-efficient selection of presets
sources.boundary: Median25 comparisons is their simulation finding and cannot substantiate universal five-query convergence
